entry.name: nrpnout
entry.description: Format 14-bit MIDI Non-Registered Parameter Number messages to be transmitted using the midiout object.

arguments.name: parameter-channel
arguments.description: The initial argument is an initial non-registered parameter number (in the range 0-16383) to be used in parameter changes messages formatted by. Non-registered parameter numbers are automatically limited between 0 and 16383. The parameter number can also be expressed as a symbol formatted 'MSB:LSB' (for instance, '1:0' would specify parameter 128). If there is no controller number specified, the initial controller number is 0.Following the controller number argument is an initial value for the channel number with which to format control messages. If the channel argument is not present,initially formats control messages on channel 1. In order for this argument to be used, a controller number argument must precede it. The channel number is clipped to the range 1-16.

attributes.name: hires
attributes.digest: High resolution value mode
attributes.description: When enabled,formats high resolution, 14-bit NRPN messages for the provided input. If you know that the parameter you are working with only responds to 7-bit values using the MSB, settoto avoid inaccurate output from the object. If the parameter you are working with responds to 'high resolution' 7-bit values using an MSB of 0 and a value in the LSB, this setting will have no effect.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends out a non-registered parameter message using the numbers currently stored in

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In middle-left inlet: The delta will be formatted into a complete MIDI non-registered parameter number message by. Deltas outside of the range -127-127 will be ignored.

messages.name: in2
messages.digest: Set the active non-registered parameter number
messages.description: In middle-right inlet: The number is stored as the non-registered parameter number of the messages transmitted by. Parameter numbers outside of the range 0-16383 will be ignored.

messages.name: in3
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the MIDI channel for the continuous controller message sent out by. Channel numbers will be clipped to stay within the 1-16 range.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is a 14-bit non-registered parameter value to be formatted into a complete MIDI non-registered parameter number message by.

messages.name: list
messages.description: A pair of two 7-bit values, most significant byte (MSB) followed by least significant byte (LSB). The 7-bit MSB will be bitshifted and ORd with the 7-bit LSB to specify a 14-bit non-registered parameter value. The 14-bit value will be formatted into a complete MIDI non-registered parameter number message by.

inlets.digest: Parameter Value (0-16383 or list MSB LSB)
